title: I built a Chrome extension that turns your "read later" list into dedicated reading time on your calendar. Save 5 articles → it auto-books a 30-min "reading block" on your Google calendar, links included. So you'll actually sit down and go through them. No account, no server, everything local. Open source (link below)
